en.name: Lactose-free milk
en.summary: Lactose-free milk is ordinary cow's milk with the enzyme lactase added to split the lactose into simpler sugars. It is still milk and still perishable: keep it cold, follow the date on an unopened carton, and use it within about 1 week of opening.
en.pantry: Chilled lactose-free milk must not be left out. It is dairy in every respect that matters for storage, so follow the 2-hour rule, or 1 hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F), and put the carton back as soon as you have poured. UHT lactose-free milk in an aseptic carton is a different case and can sit in the cupboard until you open it, after which it belongs in the fridge like any other.
en.fridge: Keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, on an inside shelf rather than the door. Unopened, follow the use-by date on the carton. Once opened, use it within about 1 week, with the cap closed and the carton upright. One thing catches people out: lactose-free milk often tastes noticeably sweeter than regular milk, because lactase splits lactose into glucose and galactose, which taste sweeter than the sugar they came from. That sweetness is not a sign that it is turning.
en.freezer: There is no published freezer timeline for lactose-free milk. Freezing is possible but the fat and protein separate, and thawed milk is grainy and watery — fine for baking or a cooked sauce, poor for a cup of tea. If you do it, freeze it at −18 °C (0 °F) in a container with headspace, because milk expands as it freezes, and shake the thawed milk hard. Buying the size you will actually drink is a better answer.
en.thawing: Thaw it in the fridge, never on the counter, and shake it hard before pouring. Use it within a day or two and do not refreeze it.
spoilage: A sour or sharp smell instead of a clean, faintly sweet dairy one.
Lumps, curdled strands or a thickened pour.
A swollen carton, or gas escaping when you open it.
A bitter or fizzy taste, or slime around the spout.
tips: Buy the size you will finish in a week once opened.
Keep it on a shelf, not in the door — the door is the warmest part of the fridge.
Do not drink from the carton if you are keeping the rest.
Write the opening date on the carton.

faq.q: How long does lactose-free milk last after opening?
faq.a: About 1 week at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, kept closed and upright.

faq.q: Does lactose-free milk keep longer than ordinary milk?
faq.a: Not because of the lactase. UHT versions last longer unopened because of the heat treatment and the aseptic carton, not because the lactose was removed.
There is no established timeline. It separates and goes grainy, so freeze it only for baking or cooking, at −18 °C with headspace in the container.

faq.q: Why does lactose-free milk taste sweeter?
faq.a: Lactase splits lactose into glucose and galactose, which taste sweeter. That is normal and not a sign of spoilage.

zh.name: 無乳糖牛奶
zh.summary: 無乳糖牛奶就是加了乳糖酶、把乳糖分解成更小的糖的一般牛奶。它仍然是牛奶，也一樣容易腐敗：全程冷藏，未開封以包裝日期為準，開封後約 1 週內喝完。
zh.pantry: 冷藏型無乳糖牛奶不能放在室溫。就保存而言，它和一般鮮乳沒有差別，請守 2 小時原則（廚房超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時），倒完立刻冰回去。無菌包裝的保久型則是另一回事，開封前可以放櫥櫃，開封後同樣要冷藏。
zh.fridge: 放在 4 °C 以下的內側層架，不要放門邊。未開封以包裝上的有效日期為準。開封後請在約 1 週內喝完，蓋子關緊、盒身直立。有一點常讓人誤會：無乳糖牛奶通常嚐起來比一般牛奶更甜，因為乳糖酶把乳糖分解成葡萄糖和半乳糖，而這兩種比原本的乳糖甜。那股甜味不是變質的跡象。
zh.freezer: 無乳糖牛奶沒有公告的冷凍期限。冷凍做得到，但脂肪和蛋白質會分離，解凍後質地粗又水——拿去烘焙或煮醬汁沒問題，泡茶就不行。真要冷凍，請放 −18 °C，容器要留膨脹空間（牛奶結冰會膨脹），解凍後用力搖勻。買喝得完的容量才是更好的答案。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍，不要放室溫，倒之前用力搖勻。解凍後一兩天內喝完，不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 聞起來發酸或刺鼻，而不是乾淨微甜的乳香。
出現結塊、凝絮，或倒起來變稠。
包裝鼓脹，或開封時有氣體逸出。
吃起來發苦或有氣泡感，吸嘴周圍發黏。
tips: 買開封後一週內喝得完的容量。
放層架不要放門邊——門邊是冰箱最溫暖的位置。
還要留著喝的話，不要直接對著盒口喝。

faq.q: 無乳糖牛奶開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 蓋緊直立放 4 °C 以下，大約 1 週。

faq.q: 無乳糖牛奶比一般牛奶耐放嗎？
faq.a: 不是因為乳糖酶。保久型之所以未開封放得久，是因為高溫殺菌和無菌包裝，跟去除乳糖無關。

faq.q: 無乳糖牛奶可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 沒有既定期限。它會分離、質地變粗，只適合冷凍後用於烘焙或料理；請放 −18 °C，容器留膨脹空間。

faq.q: 無乳糖牛奶為什麼比較甜？
faq.a: 乳糖酶把乳糖分解成葡萄糖和半乳糖，這兩種嚐起來比較甜。這是正常的，不是壞掉。
